text.tspan: Lord, Have Access to My Inner Being
Make Yourself at home in every room.
Transform every corner; make it You.
Have Your way, have Your will.
Don’t let me stop You from doing
It fills me up and makes it hard
So You can work in every part
Lord, make my heart the kind of home
What makes You comfortable, at ease?
Lord, tell me, what makes You smile?
What makes You pleased? What’s Your desire?
Do what You need to do in me.
